verdict.rationale: Mastercard documents a Sandbox project on a non-billable, unlimited Test Drive plan that covers all Open Finance endpoints. It also provides test banks (FinBanks), a test payroll provider (FinPayroll), and testing personas with a wide variety of profiles for different use-case scenarios, and accounts are linked via Connect. Together these cover the core of end-to-end testing for linking and data retrieval before touching a real bank. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the actual test credentials (usernames/passwords per persona), explicit evidence of simulating error states (e.g., MFA failures, invalid credentials, institution outages), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox experience.
